input.description:
**Repo(s):** `agent-skills-linear-workflow` (NEW)
**Executor model:** Sonnet 4.6 — the logic is simple (surface the index); the risk is the hook contract + plugin-root variable. This is load-bearing for install-anywhere (KR1).

## Scope

Author the `SessionStart` hook that injects `rules/GOVERNANCE.md` into every session, resolved through the plugin-root path variable (not a home path) so it works on any machine with the pack installed.

## [GATE] Verify the contract before building — hallucination is the default; sources are the brake

Do **not** assert the hook mechanism. Confirm against current Claude Code docs (the `claude-code-guide` agent / source-driven-development), reusing what issue 1 recorded:
- The exact `SessionStart` hook contract — how a plugin registers it, how injected content reaches the session context, output format.
- The plugin-root path variable (e.g. `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`) for locating `GOVERNANCE.md` portably.

If the verified contract can't deliver reliable injection, **stop** and surface it — this is the initiative's kill condition (fallback: ship without the hook + one documented per-machine import line). Do not silently ship a hook that might not fire.

## Verification — run by a subagent, not self-certified

**Subagent model:** Sonnet 4.6 (semantic + live-load check).
**Prompt for the verification subagent:**

> You are verifying a SessionStart hook, read-only. Do **not** edit anything to make a check pass. Report **PASS/FAIL per check with raw evidence** (config excerpts, the actual SessionStart output of a new session) — never "looks correct".
> 1. The hook is registered per the **verified** contract (cite the doc/source the implementer recorded; confirm the registration matches it). (Paste the hook config.)
> 2. It locates `GOVERNANCE.md` via the plugin-root variable, **not** a `/Users/anton/...` path: `grep -rn "/Users/anton" <hook files>` returns nothing. (Paste output.)
> 3. **Live load:** on a clean Claude profile with the pack installed, start a new session and confirm its SessionStart output contains the GOVERNANCE index, and that `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` was **not** edited to achieve it. (Paste the SessionStart output excerpt showing the index.)
> On any FAIL: report the gap and return the issue to In Progress. KR1 ("installs and loads with zero per-machine config") rides on check 3.

**Repo(s):** `agent-skills-shaper`
**Executor model:** Sonnet 4.6 — touches several Shaper files; must leave no dangling Linear reference (verified by KR2's grep).

## Scope

With the artefacts moved out (issue 266), remove every remaining trace of Linear from the Shaper pack so adopting Shaper never implies a tracker.

- Confirm `rules/linear-workflow.md` and `skills/initiative-shape/` are gone from `agent-skills-shaper` (the move in 266 should have removed them; delete any remnant).
- Scrub Linear from the Shaper-facing prose:
  - `skills/using-this-pack/` (or equivalent onboarding skill) — remove Linear/initiative mentions.
  - `README.md` — remove Linear/initiative-shape from tables and prose.
  - `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` — remove the `## Linear workflow` section and the `linear-workflow.md` import; keep only the path-free pointer the wired repos use (the uniform governance block), or nothing if Shaper isn't itself a wired consumer.
- Leave Shaper's principle files (`PRODUCT_RULES.md`, `eng-principles-*.md`) and their load steps untouched — they stay in Shaper.

## Verification — run by a subagent, not self-certified

**Subagent model:** Haiku 4.5 (grep/inspection).
**Prompt for the verification subagent:**

> You are verifying that the Shaper pack is tracker-agnostic, read-only. Do **not** edit anything to make a check pass. Report **PASS/FAIL per check with raw evidence** (command output) — never "looks correct".
> 1. `rules/linear-workflow.md` and `skills/initiative-shape/` no longer exist under `agent-skills-shaper`. (Paste `ls` showing absence.)
> 2. `grep -rni "linear\|initiative-shape" /Users/anton/src/agent-skills-shaper/` returns nothing. (Paste output — must be empty.)
> 3. `grep -rn "four-field" /Users/anton/src/agent-skills-shaper/` returns nothing (drift gone). (Paste output.)
> 4. Shaper's principle files remain: `ls agent-skills-shaper/rules/` shows `PRODUCT_RULES.md` and `eng-principles-*.md`. (Paste `ls`.)
> On any FAIL: report the gap and return the issue to In Progress. This issue is the primary grader for KR2 (checks 1–2).

input.title: Trim global CLAUDE.md: drop the rule imports and the Comments section
input.description:
**Repo(s):** global `~/.claude` config (not a repo)
**Executor model:** Sonnet 4.6 — small but high-blast-radius (every session). Order matters: only safe once the hook (issue 268) loads governance, so removing the imports loses nothing.

## Scope

Now that the SessionStart hook injects governance, the global `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` no longer needs to import the rule files or carry the comment standard.

- Remove the four rule `@`-imports (`PRODUCT_RULES.md`, `eng-principles-universal.md`, `eng-principles-agentic.md`, `linear-workflow.md`).
- Remove the `## Comments` section (it now lives inline in `GOVERNANCE.md` — issue 267).
- **Keep** `@RTK.md` and the `## Learning and Memory Management` (journal) section — these are personal, Claude-specific tooling, not shared governance.

## [GATE] Sequencing — do not run before the hook works

Verify the SessionStart hook (issue 268) is installed and injecting `GOVERNANCE.md` **before** removing the imports. Removing them first would leave sessions with no governance. If the hook isn't confirmed live, stop.

## Verification — run by a subagent, not self-certified

**Subagent model:** Haiku 4.5 (grep/inspection).
**Prompt for the verification subagent:**

> You are verifying a trim of the global Claude config, read-only. Do **not** edit anything to make a check pass. Report **PASS/FAIL per check with raw evidence** (command output, file excerpts) — never "looks correct".
> 1. `grep -n "@" ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` shows no rule `@`-imports (no PRODUCT_RULES / eng-principles / linear-workflow). (Paste output.)
> 2. The `## Comments` section is gone. (Paste `grep -n "## Comments" ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` — empty.)
> 3. `@RTK.md` and the `## Learning and Memory Management` section **remain**. (Quote both.)
> 4. Confirm governance still reaches a session by another path: a new session's SessionStart output shows the GOVERNANCE index (the hook, not the removed imports). (Paste the index excerpt.)
> On any FAIL: report the gap and return the issue to In Progress. Check 4 is the safety interlock — if it fails, governance was lost; restore the imports until the hook works.


input.description:
**Repo(s):** `stock-review`
**Executor model:** Haiku 4.5 — trivial: a one-line "what this is" plus the uniform block, and a shim.

## Scope

`stock-review` has no AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md governance. Create stubs that point at the pack.

- Create `stock-review/AGENTS.md`: a one-line "what this repo is" (*owner to confirm the line*) + the uniform governance block (swap `<repo>` → `stock-review`).
- Create `stock-review/CLAUDE.md` as an `@AGENTS.md` shim.
- Same path-free uniform block as the other wired repos (names `rules/GOVERNANCE.md`).

## Verification — run by a subagent, not self-certified

**Subagent model:** Haiku 4.5 (grep/inspection).
**Prompt for the verification subagent:**

> You are verifying two new stub files, read-only. Do **not** edit anything to make a check pass. Report **PASS/FAIL per check with raw evidence** (file excerpts, command output) — never "looks correct".
> 1. `stock-review/AGENTS.md` exists, opens with a one-line "what this is", and carries one Workflow-pack pointer naming `rules/GOVERNANCE.md`. (Paste the file.)
> 2. `stock-review/CLAUDE.md` exists and is an `@AGENTS.md` shim. (Paste the file.)
> 3. Neither restates Linear and neither carries an absolute path: `grep -n "## Linear workflow\|/Users/anton" stock-review/AGENTS.md stock-review/CLAUDE.md` returns nothing. (Paste output.)
